scope: live render/light ownership keys and worker protocols

canonicalIdentity.blockStorage: ChunkColumn(chunkX,chunkZ) -> lazy ChunkSection(inColumnSectionIndex), with global sectionY = minSectionY + inColumnSectionIndex
canonicalIdentity.lightStorage: WorldLightStorage section key (sectionX,sectionY,sectionZ), derived from floor world coordinates / 16
canonicalIdentity.legacyProjection: ChunkManager column map (chunkX,chunkZ) -> Chunk(cx,cy,cz) compatibility slabs; cy is a 64-block slab coordinate

owners.key: horizontal chunkX,chunkZ plus in-column section index
owners.version: ChunkSection.meshVersion; absent sections read as air/version 0
owners.lifecycle: VerticalWorldAccess/CanonicalWorldStorage own column residency and serialization
markEvicting cancels work; finalizeEviction removes record; resetForRegeneration increments generation

owners.resource: live compatibility meshes, retry queue, voxel/triangle counters
owners.key: chunkKey(cx,cy,cz) for meshGroups, chunkTriangles, chunkVoxelCounts, retryMeshQueue and lightDirtyChunks
owners.version: pipeline generation plus legacy Chunk.meshVersion; synchronous mesher inputVersion is pipeline generation
owners.lifecycle: removeMeshesForChunk disposes geometry; unload removes slab projection and prunes light sections
deleteSection on unload; clear/restore for world reset/snapshot

owners.key: world-cell coordinates in queue entries; pruneSection uses section coordinates
owners.version: per-channel queue versions and combined LightUpdateEngine.version
owners.lifecycle: bounded drain; clearPending/pruneSection discard queued work without silently changing stored light
pending map resolves exactly once; cancel/cancelByToken makes late results stale

owners.key: request/result sectionX,sectionY,sectionZ; matched against stored request
owners.lifecycle: malformed/foreign/stale/duplicate results are rejected; callback completion is exactly once

owners.key: Chunk cx,cy,cz and 64-block slab origin; typed result carries inputVersion
owners.version: MeshBuildResult.inputVersion, supplied by World pipeline generation
owners.lifecycle: World.attach replaces/disposes geometry by slab key

synchronousMesh.staleCheck: World compares streams.inputVersion to pipeline record.generation; legacy un-stamped results remain compatibility behavior

workerMesh.staleCheck: jobId/kind/generationToken plus section coordinate equality, then World pipeline generation and Chunk.meshVersion

light.staleCheck: sectionVersions and queue versions are available; World remeshes generated slab projections tracked in lightDirtyChunks

knownMigrationGaps: World render ownership maps and lightDirtyChunks remain keyed by legacy 64-high slab identity.
World worker payload construction iterates six 64-high slab sections and derives sectionY from cy * sectionsPerChunk + local index.
Live synchronous/worker mesh attachment is still slab-owned even though worker payloads carry canonical section coordinates.
WorldLightStorage section versions are not yet joined to live mesh submission/application at canonical section granularity.

dispositions.canonicalSectionStorageAndLight: PROJECTION_ONLY consumers may read it, but no second writable truth may be introduced
dispositions.legacyChunkAndChunkManager: PROJECTION_ONLY until section-scoped live rendering/lighting migration completes
dispositions.pipelineAndWorkerTokens: MIGRATE carefully; preserve exact stale/cancel/duplicate rejection
dispositions.futureProductionChanges: Do not enable worker meshing or remove compatibility projections until task-specific parity and stale-resource tests pass
